##### Project general facts

Najd Three represents a residential concept developed by Reportage Properties that combines modern European architectural aesthetics with traditional Saudi design elements. The master plan incorporates clean structural lines and timeless materials to establish long-term aesthetic value. The overall structural composition blends heritage-inspired craftsmanship with contemporary building practices.

The development includes a broad range of private community amenities and lifestyle facilities. Residents have access to private walkways, expansive green areas, a dedicated sports club, and leisure facilities including private screening options. The internal infrastructure features local retail outlets, cafes, restaurants, and a neighborhood mosque.

The collection of residences features one-bedroom simplex apartments and two-bedroom duplex layouts. Each residence includes central air conditioning, fully fitted kitchen cabinetry with countertops, modern tiled bathrooms, and dedicated storage solutions. The spatial design incorporates private balconies, terraces, and expansive rooftop gardens for duplex units, supported by private underground parking facilities.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

The surrounding neighborhood of Al Rimal offers a balanced lifestyle environment set along scenic natural terrain near Wadi Tanhal. The area presents an established residential atmosphere characterized by quiet surroundings and active development. It provides a calm setting that naturally bridges natural landscapes with urban convenience.

The immediate area hosts notable cultural institutions, educational facilities, and sports venues. Major points of interest in the vicinity include King Abdulaziz Equestrian Field, King Fahad Stadium, King Fahd Security College, and Naif College for National Security. The district regularly hosts cultural gatherings, such as events connected to the National Festival for Heritage & Culture.

The vicinity features convenient access to major transport routes that connect directly to the wider region. International travel and public transit hubs, including King Khalid International Airport, are easily accessible. Key regional medical institutions like Sultan bin Abdulaziz Humanitarian City are also situated within the surrounding network.
